new_scholarship.name: Borse di studio offerte dal Governo italiano a studenti stranieri e italiani residenti all'estero (IRE)
new_scholarship.official_source: Ministero degli Affari Esteri e della Cooperazione Internazionale (MAECI)
new_scholarship.deadline: Le candidature online devono pervenire tassativamente entro le ore 14.00 (ora italiana) del 26 marzo 2026
new_scholarship.application_period: Annual call, published in the first quarter of the year for the following academic year; the 2026-2027 call closed at 14:00 Italian time on 26 March 2026
new_scholarship.application_method: Separate application, not automatic on admission: candidates may apply only through the Study in Italy portal (https://studyinitaly.esteri.it)

programme_detail_official.deadline_note: Dead in the past as at 2026-10-03. Next cycle expected in the first quarter of 2027 for academic year 2027-2028.
programme_detail_official.status_note: The 2026-2027 call closed at 14:00 (ora italiana) on 26 March 2026; the Study in Italy portal states the call for applications is now closed and asks candidates to watch the site for the next academic year.
programme_detail_official.citizenship_residency: Foreign students resident abroad, plus Italian citizens resident abroad (IRE) who hold Italian citizenship only; selection is by nationality and candidates may compete for one country only
programme_detail_official.study_mode: in person on Italian territory only
programme_detail_official.application_method: Not automatic on admission. Candidates may apply only through the Study in Italy portal; only applications and documents submitted through that portal are valid.
programme_detail_official.application_route: online application via the Study in Italy portal
selection_criteria: Selection is based on nationality: candidates compete for one beneficiary country only

official_contacts.office: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Directorate General for Growth and Export Promotion - Office VII, Promotion of Italophony

programme_detail_official.coverage: The ministry states the scholarship covers only attendance of courses on Italian territory.
